name: QR Manager AI API
description:
The QR Manager AI REST API lets you create, manage, and analyse QR codes
programmatically. All endpoints require an API key issued from
**Settings → API Keys**.

### Authentication

Pass your API key as a Bearer token in every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer qrm_your_api_key_here
```

### Plan requirements

| Tier | Access |
|---|---|
| **Free** | No API access |
| **Starter** | List, get, analytics, notifications, folders (read + write) |
| **Pro / Enterprise** | Full access including create, update, and delete QR codes |

### Base URL

```
https://qr-manager.ai/api/v1
```
